newsitem.title: USA: Dura to buy 2 intranasal steroid products.
newsitem.headline: Dura to buy 2 intranasal steroid products.

text.p: Dura Pharmaceuticals Inc said it has signed agreements to acquire the intranasal steroid products Nasare1 and Nasalide Nasal Solutions 0.025 percent from Syntex (USA) Inc for $70 million plus additional contingent payment amounts.
Syntex is a Roche Holding Ltd unit.
The transaction is expected to close this week, Dura said. The company said it believes that combined first full-year sales for the two products could be $25 to $30 million.
Dura said it expects Nasarel and Nasalide to have a positive impact on its financial position.
"We expect that the products will be accretive to earnings despite our immediate investments in sales force expansion and product promotion," noted Cam Garner, Dura's chairman and chief executive.

A portion of the revenues from the products will fund the expansion of Dura's sales force by 50 representatives who will target respiratory specialists. These new positions are in addition to a previously planned expansion, bringing the expected sales force total to 300 by the end of 1997.

"The acquisition of Nasarel and Nasalide is expected to accelerate our plans to reach 350 representatives in time for the launch of its first Spiros inhaler product, Spiros albuterol, expected in late 1998," said Garner.
